_source: Hidden: the six Steam lists without a description. Names: Steam (steamcommunity.com/stats/2835570/achievements).

achievements.name: 70K
achievements.description: Beat the standard game (all 3 rounds) for the first time.

achievements.name: Bronze Gates
achievements.description: Die during round 3 in normal/story mode.

achievements.name: Chasing Losses
achievements.description: Consume the Double or Nothing pills to start the mode.

achievements.name: Overdose
achievements.description: Start the Double or Nothing mode 10 times.

achievements.name: Nope!
achievements.description: Cash out immediately on your first run in Double or Nothing.

achievements.name: 140K
achievements.description: Double your earnings and win/cash out in Double or Nothing.

achievements.name: 1000K
achievements.description: Cash out over $1,000,000 in Double or Nothing.

achievements.name: Coin Flip
achievements.description: Shoot yourself with a blank when there are equal live and blank shells, without the magnifying glass or burner phone.

achievements.name: Digita, Orava and Koni
achievements.description: Use Beer, Cigarette Pack and Expired Medicine in a single turn.

achievements.name: Know When To Quit
achievements.description: Lose/die after accumulating more than $1,000,000 in Double or Nothing.

achievements.name: Name Taken
achievements.description: Enter the name "GOD" when signing the waiver.

achievements.name: Full House
achievements.description: Use all available items in a single turn in Double or Nothing (needs a stolen item).

achievements.name: Why?
achievements.description: Use the magnifying glass to see a live round, then shoot yourself.

achievements.name: Soak It In
achievements.description: Stay in the hallway and listen to the club music for over a minute.

achievements.name: Going Out With Style!
achievements.description: Saw off the barrel, shoot yourself with a live round, and die.

achievements.name: High Rollers
achievements.description: Check the leaderboard on the TV.
